    The primitive quotient A/AeA #

    This file identifies the coordinate-zero deletion used by the compiled primitive mesh package with the frozen manuscript's literal quotient by the two-sided ideal AeA.

            theorem MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.primitiveMultiplicity_eq_zero_iff_isAnnihilatedBy {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] [IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ] (S : FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton k A) {e : A} (D : PrimitiveIdempotentData e) (x : Fin S.n) :
